import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import Redlock from 'redlock';

@Injectable()
class UnsupportedLockWrappers {
  private deferred: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined;

  constructor(private readonly redlock: Redlock) {}

  async executeWithLock<T>(lockKey: string, task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.redlock.using([lockKey], 5_000, async () => task());
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:ignored-callback
  async neverInvokes<T>(_task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return undefined as T;
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:outside-section
  async invokesOutsideSection<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const result = await task();
    await this.redlock.using(['lock:outside'], 5_000, async () => undefined);
    return result;
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:stored-callback
  async storesForLater(task: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    this.deferred = task;
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:nested-scheduler
  async schedulesInsideSection<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.redlock.using(['lock:scheduled'], 5_000, async () => Promise.resolve().then(task));
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:transformed-forwarding
  async transformsCallback<T>(lockKey: string, task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.executeWithLock(lockKey, async () => task());
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:spread-forwarding
  async spreadsArguments<T>(lockKey: string, task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const forwarded = [lockKey, task] as const;
    return this.executeWithLock(...forwarded);
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:cycle-one
  async cycleOne<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.cycleTwo(task);
  }

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:cycle-two
  async cycleTwo<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.cycleOne(task);
  }
}

class RedlockLookalike {
  async using<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return task();
  }
}

@Injectable()
class LookalikeWrapper {
  constructor(private readonly redlock: RedlockLookalike) {}

  // CSW0_NEGATIVE:package-lookalike
  async execute<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.redlock.using(task);
  }
}

@Injectable()
class UnsupportedCaller {
  private readonly complete = async (): Promise<void> => undefined;

  constructor(private readonly locks: UnsupportedLockWrappers) {}

  // CSW0_CASE:ignored-callback
  ignored(): Promise<string> {
    return this.locks.neverInvokes(async () => 'ignored');
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:outside-section
  outside(): Promise<string> {
    return this.locks.invokesOutsideSection(async () => 'outside');
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:stored-callback
  stored(): Promise<void> {
    return this.locks.storesForLater(async () => undefined);
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:nested-scheduler
  scheduled(): Promise<string> {
    return this.locks.schedulesInsideSection(async () => 'scheduled');
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:transformed-forwarding
  transformed(): Promise<string> {
    return this.locks.transformsCallback('lock:transformed', async () => 'transformed');
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:spread-forwarding
  spread(): Promise<string> {
    return this.locks.spreadsArguments('lock:spread', async () => 'spread');
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:cycle
  cycle(): Promise<string> {
    return this.locks.cycleOne(async () => 'cycle');
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:method-reference
  methodReference(): Promise<void> {
    return this.locks.executeWithLock('lock:reference', this.complete);
  }
}

if (Date.now() < 0) {
  throw new Error('CSW0 unsupported wrapper fixture must never execute');
}
